author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಿ ಸಂಸ್ಕಾರ ಸನ್ನಡತೆ
ನೆಪವಿಡದೆ ಗಳಿಸಿಡಲು ಕಾಯುವವು ಸತತ
ವಿಪದಗಳ ಸುಳಿವಿರವು ನಡೆನುಡಿಯು ಶುದ್ಧವಿರೆ
ಅಪಹಾಸ್ಯ ತರದಿಹವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The wealth in life is culture and good conduct;
if you earn and store them without excuses, they guard you always;
when words and deeds are pure, there is no trace of calamity;
they never bring you ridicule, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Culture and good conduct are life’s real wealth. Earned sincerely, they protect us always; clean speech and action keep away both disaster and disgrace.
